entries.brief: Create ONE original square painterly fantasy bestiary illustration for SKAZ D&D 2014. Full body of a young newly hatched dragon wyrmling, compact juvenile proportions, larger head, short thick neck, FOUR distinct walking legs and TWO batlike wings as separate limbs, one tail. All feet, wing tips and tail visible inside canvas with clear padding. Broad sculpted painted shapes, restrained natural materials, warm upper-left light and defined edges readable on ivory and charcoal. Distinctive recognizable silhouette at 32 pixels. True transparent background, no ground, scenery, egg, text, numbers, border, watermark, magic haze or particles. Black dragon wyrmling crouched in three-quarter view facing left. Glossy charcoal-black scales, skeletal narrow face, two ivory horns curving forward alongside cheeks, small frilled neck, dusky olive wing membranes. Short tail curved to right. Menacing but clearly juvenile, no skull separate from head, no breath cloud.
